name: process-hygiene
description: Developer-only, not scheduled. Report, and with --reap stop, orphaned processes (PPID 1, owned by this user, older than a threshold) whose cwd is inside the scratchpad of an ended agent session; --spotlight keeps Spotlight out of scratchpads. Contributes no tools; manifest present to DECLARE config per skills/MANIFEST.md: PROCESS_HYGIENE_MIN_AGE_S is the minimum age in seconds before an orphan is a candidate; PROCESS_HYGIENE_GRACE_S is the wait between SIGTERM and SIGKILL; PROCESS_HYGIENE_WITNESS_REAP="1" lets scripts/witness-reap.sh pass --reap at the end of a witness (default "0": report-only).
